_about: Changes newer than visa.json, applied on top of it. Each rule matches a destination and a list of passports. Keep sources so the next person can check them.

rules.summary: South Africa's Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) replaces the e-visa for short visits. Apply online before you fly; approval usually comes within 24 to 72 hours.
notes: The fee is R500 (about US$30). Other visa fees may apply depending on your nationality.
Stays of up to 90 days for tourism or business. You can ask Home Affairs to extend by up to 90 more days.
South Africa's old e-visa closes on 1 December 2026, so apply through the ETA.
At launch, ETA entries were only valid through OR Tambo (Johannesburg), Cape Town International and Lanseria airports. Check this when you apply.
checklist: Apply for your South Africa ETA at eta.dha.gov.za (R500 fee)
Apply at least a week before you fly, in case Home Affairs asks for more documents
Save your ETA approval on your phone and print a copy
Fly into OR Tambo, Cape Town International or Lanseria, unless your ETA says otherwise
Plan to stay no more than 90 days

notes: You can also apply for South Africa's optional Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) at eta.dha.gov.za, which can speed up arrival. It is not required for your passport.
South Africa's e-visa closes on 1 December 2026. Check with the South African embassy whether you can apply through the new ETA or need a visa from the embassy.

rules.title: Holiday visits not allowed
rules.summary: Seychelles does not admit Nigerian passport holders travelling for a holiday. Only holders of diplomatic passports or Seychelles work or residence permits are exempt.
notes: Other visits are judged case by case through the Seychelles Electronic Border System, and many are refused.
checklist: Check with Seychelles immigration before you book anything

notes: UAE visas for Nigerians have come with extra conditions since 2025. Reports say applicants aged 18 to 45 travelling alone may be refused a tourist visa, a 6-month bank statement with about US$10,000 a month is asked for, and transit visas were suspended.

In June 2026 the UAE ambassador said restrictions had eased and Nigerians were no longer being refused, but agents still report strict checks. Apply through your airline or an approved agent and confirm the current conditions.
checklist: Apply through your airline (such as Emirates) or an approved UAE visa agent
Six months of personal bank statements
Confirmed return flight and hotel booking

notes: Since 25 February 2026 UK visas for Nigerians are digital eVisas, with no sticker in your passport. You will need a UKVI account to view and share yours.
checklist: Create your UKVI account and link your eVisa to your passport

notes: Visitor visa processing for Nigerians was taking around 100 days in October 2026, so apply at least four months ahead.
The Republic of the Congo has announced visa-free entry for Nigerians from 1 January 2027, with some administrative conditions. Until then you still need a visa.

rules.title: US entry suspended
rules.summary: Since 1 January 2026 the US has suspended entry for visitors and immigrants with this passport, under Presidential Proclamation 10998. If you already hold a valid US visa issued before then, you may still travel on it.
notes: Visas issued before 1 January 2026 stay valid until they expire.
Exempt: green card holders, dual nationals travelling on another country's passport, diplomats and athletes for major events.
The US reviews the list every 180 days; the next review is due around 11 December 2026.
checklist: Check your US visa was issued before 1 January 2026 and is valid for your whole trip
Check the latest US State Department guidance before you book

rules.title: Visitor visas suspended
rules.summary: Since 1 January 2026 the US is not issuing visitor (B-1/B-2), student (F, M) or exchange (J) visas to holders of this passport, under Presidential Proclamation 10998. If you already hold a valid US visa issued before then, you can still travel on it. Other visa types may be issued with shorter validity.
notes: Visas issued before 1 January 2026 stay valid until they expire.
Exempt: green card holders, dual nationals travelling on another country's passport, diplomats and athletes for major events.
The US reviews the list every 180 days; the next review is due around 11 December 2026.
checklist: Check your US visa was issued before 1 January 2026 and is valid for your whole trip
Check the latest US State Department guidance before you book
Carry proof of why you are visiting and your return ticket

notes: US immigrant visas are suspended for this passport under Presidential Proclamation 10998. Visitor and student visas are not affected.
Malaysia's visa-free entry for Indian citizens ends on 31 December 2026. From 1 January 2027 you will need a visa; online applications open on 1 December 2026.
